svg.text: Label-free runs each sample alone. TMT pools 16–18 samples into one run — and that run is a batch.
No limit on the number of samples
→ run order and drift are the batch
② TMT: tag, pool, run once
isobaric tags separate only after fragmentation
MS2 reporter ions: one bar per sample
pooled reference, same in every plex
a shared reference to bridge them
⚠️ Ratio compression: co-isolated peptides pull every TMT ratio towards 1, so fold changes are underestimated.
💡 §5 ② (batch design) made concrete: a 100-patient cohort is 6–7 plexes, and so 6–7 batches.
